function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: replan_graph
function.description: Expand/adjust graph `time_window_days`, `max_hops`, and `amount_tolerance` within policy bounds.

parameters.description: Bounded graph replanning tool; consumes 1 replan slot, increments `replan_count`, and rescans flows.

time_window_days.description: Updated lookahead window in days within policy bounds

max_hops.description: Updated maximum hops within policy bounds

amount_tolerance.description: Updated Decimal tolerance ratio within policy bounds (e.g. '0.15')

reason.description: Evidence-grounded contradiction or gap motivating the replan

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

response.text:
Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory extraction and escalation checklist (concise)

Summary of applicable obligations and red flags (exact clause IDs)
- Scatter-gather layering that disperses funds across intermediary accounts and then reconsolidates is a red flag requiring prompt STR scrutiny: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01 (FIU-IND Banking Sector Red Flag Indicators — Rapid Pass-Through & Scatter‑Gather Layering). FIU-IND specifically flags reconsolidation into a common beneficiary within ~7–30 days as indicative of deliberate layering (see FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01).

- PMLA liability for knowingly assisting concealment / layering and requirement to evaluate commercial substance: PMLA-2002-S3-P03 (PMLA 2002 — Section 3 read with Section 2(1)(u)). Analysts should test whether intermediary hops lack commercial substance before recommending escalation.

- “Suspicious transaction” definition and requirement to evaluate absence of economic rationale: PMLR-2005-R2-P02 (PMLR Rules, Rule 2(1)(g)(iii)-(iv)). If a transaction appears to have no bona fide purpose or gives reasonable grounds for suspicion, it triggers STR scrutiny.

- Structuring/threshold-evasion is itself a red flag and must be aggregated across rolling monthly windows: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 (FIU-IND Red Flag — Structuring / Smurfing below INR 10 lakh) and PMLR-2005-R3-P05 (PMLR Rules, Rule 3(1)(B) on integrally connected cash structuring). Aggregation of linked legs that together exceed thresholds triggers STR obligations even if individual legs are below thresholds.

- Role/timeline for escalation to the Principal Officer and required packaging for review: PMLR-2005-R7-P03 (PMLR Rule 7 — Principal Officer). Analyst worksheets must present competing hypotheses, supporting/contradicting evidence IDs, citations, and list of missing out‑of‑bank evidence to enable Principal Officer review within the seven working‑day window.

- Internal SOPs requiring dual hypothesis, corroboration of benign explanations, and non-reliance on single registry flags: SOP-SG-007 (Dual Competing Hypotheses Mandate), SOP-SG-003 (Benign Look‑Alikes Corroboration), SOP-SG-006 (Forged & Uncorroborated Registry Defense). These require confirming commercial registrations, counterparty cadence, recurring settlement history and alignment with declared turnover before closing as benign.

- International standard on aggregating split transfers / linked legs (supporting aggregation practice): FATF-R16-P05 (FATF Recommendation 16 — split wires/linked transfers).

Immediate regulatory triggers for this case amount (INR 5,428,457.33)
- The observed amount (INR 5,428,457.33) exceeds the basic INR 10 lakh cash reporting threshold? (Note: do not compute; you have the amount). Regardless, PMLR/FIU guidance requires aggregation of linked legs across rolling monthly windows and triggers STR review when linked transfers/structuring patterns indicate threshold evasion or absence of economic rationale — see PMLR-2005-R3-P05 and FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03. FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01 indicates scatter‑gather reconsolidation within 7–30 days warrants prompt STR scrutiny.

Required next actions and timelines (regulatory citations)
1. Escalate to Principal Officer for formal review immediately and ensure Principal Officer receives a complete DispositionWorksheet within the statutory review window: PMLR-2005-R7-P03 — enable review within seven working days. Include competing hypotheses, evidence IDs, citations.

2. Prepare STR/Suspicious Transaction Report for FIU-IND if, after Principal Officer review, there are reasonable grounds for suspicion (no economic rationale, evidence of layering/structuring or threshold evasion). Relevant authorities and rules: PMLR-2005-R2-P02 (suspicious transaction definition), PMLR-2005-R3-P05 (aggregation/structuring), FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01 (scatter‑gather), FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03 (structuring). Follow FIU-IND submission standards and your institution’s Principal Officer approval process (PMLR-2005-R7-P03).

3. If the pattern shows reconsolidation within 7–30 days or rapid pass‑through dispersion with minimal residue, treat as high priority for STR consideration (FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01).

Evidence and analysis required before or alongside escalation (per clauses/SOPs)
- Reconstruct multi-hop paths and bounded lookback windows; show exact decimal conservation between dispersed outflows and consolidated inflows (FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01).
- Aggregate linked cash/electronic legs across rolling monthly windows using exact sums and timestamps (FIU-IND-RFI-BA-03; PMLR-2005-R3-P05; FATF-R16-P05).
- Produce competing benign hypotheses and corroborating evidence:
  - GST registration / valid invoices / documentary proof of commercial purpose (SOP-SG-003; SOP-SG-006).
  - Corporate payroll/vendor payout schedules, payment runs or marketplace escrow evidence (SOP-SG-003).
  - Counterparty history showing recurring cadence aligned with declared turnover (SOP-SG-006; SOP-SG-003).
- Flag missing out‑of‑bank evidence (e.g., invoices, contracts, registry extracts) explicitly in the worksheet for the Principal Officer per PMLR-2005-R7-P03 and SOP-SG-007.

Packaging checklist for the Principal Officer (must be included within seven working days)
- Dis

Summary of applicable regulatory provisions (exact citations)
- FIU-IND red-flag for scatter-gather / rapid pass-through (reconsolidation within 7–30 days; test decimal conservation; warrants prompt STR scrutiny): FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01.
- Statutory duty to report prescribed transactions and suspicious transactions to FIU-IND (includes attempted/aborted suspicious transactions): PMLA-2002-S12-P02.
- STR timing: Suspicious Transaction Reports to be furnished promptly and not later than seven working days after the Principal Officer is satisfied reasonable grounds exist; periodic CTR/CBWTR monthly by 15th of succeeding month: PMLR-2005-R8-P01.
- Cross-border wire transfer reporting threshold and requirement to verify originator/intermediary/beneficiary details when above threshold (INR 5,00,000 or foreign equivalent): PMLR-2005-R3-P07.
- Recordkeeping / reconstructability: preserve exact timestamps, account IDs, exact INR decimal amounts and payment references to enable transaction reconstruction: PMLA-2002-S12-P01.
- Confidentiality / no tipping-off customers under investigation: PMLA-2002-S12-P04.
- RBI KYC: special attention to complex / unusual patterns lacking economic rationale; document findings for at least five years; test multi-hop paths and decimal conservation: RBI-KYC-2016-P35-P02.
- RBI KYC (wire transfer): cross-border wires must carry accurate originator/beneficiary information; incomplete data may trigger risk-based holding, rejection, or STR review: RBI-KYC-2016-P64-P02.

Immediate compliance implications for alert ALT-V2-D0010
- Scatter-gather typology present (per FIU indicator) => STR-level suspicion threshold likely met if reconsolidation / pass-through signatures are observed. Cite: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01; RBI-KYC-2016-P35-P02.
- If any single cross-border outward/inward transfer leg in the observed flow exceeds INR 5,00,000 (or foreign equivalent), it is a CBWTR/subject-to-report and requires complete originator/beneficiary data and must be included in filings. Cite: PMLR-2005-R3-P07; RBI-KYC-2016-P64-P02.
- Principal Officer must decide and (if reasonable grounds) file an STR promptly and no later than seven working days from satisfaction of reasonable grounds. Cite: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; PMLA-2002-S12-P02.
- Maintain all transaction reconstructability evidence (exact amounts, timestamps, UTRs, account IDs, payment refs) to support the STR and any FIU/agency follow-up. Cite: PMLA-2002-S12-P01.
- Do not disclose to customers or otherwise tip off while investigation/STR drafting occurs. Cite: PMLA-2002-S12-P04.
- Document written rationale and supporting evidence (including why benign hypotheses were rejected or remain plausible) and retain for at least five years per RBI KYC direction. Cite: RBI-KYC-2016-P35-P02.

Suggested immediate actions (compliance checklist tied to this alert)
1. Preserve and export full evidence bundle from flow_tracer (all 44 evidence items) into an investigation file; include raw messages/UTRs, timestamps, debit/credit exact INR amounts, counterparty account numbers and payment references. (Required: PMLA-2002-S12-P01)
2. Run bounded lookback reconstruction to test for:
   - exact decimal conservation between dispersed outflows and the reconsolidated inflows;
   - reconsolidation timing (check 7–30 day window described by FIU indicator);
   - presence/absence of verified commercial registration or historical business activity for intermediary accounts. (Guidance: FIU-IND-RFI-BA-01; RBI-KYC-2016-P35-P02)
3. Identify any cross-border leg(s) and flag those above INR 5,00,000 (or foreign equivalent). For any such leg, collect complete originator/intermediary/beneficiary information (name, account no., address/ID, UTR) and escalate for CBWTR/STR consideration. (Rule: PMLR-2005-R3-P07; RBI-KYC-2016-P64-P02)
4. Decide STR escalation: if reconstruction shows scatter-gather mechanics with no reasonable economic explanation or missing/false counterparty data, Principal Officer should prepare and file an STR promptly and no later than seven working days from satisfaction of reasonable grounds. Use neutral, evidence-based language; do not allege criminal guilt. (Statute/timeline: PMLR-2005-R8-P01; PMLA-2002-S12-P02; guidance: PMLA-2002-S3-P06)
5. For any periodic threshold disclosures implicated (CTR/CBWTR/NTR), ensure monthly filings by 15th of succeeding month if applicable. (PMLR-2005-R8-P01)
6. Enforce confidentiality—no customer tipping-off, restrict access to investigation materials. (PMLA-2002-S12-P04)
7. Retain the investigation record and written findings for required retention period; document rationale and evidence trail for at least five years (RBI expectation). (RBI-KYC-2016-P35-P02; PMLA-2002-S12-P01)

Competing benign hypotheses to test (required by instructions)
- Legitimate cash-management / payroll or supply-chain payouts where upstream originator invoices match dispersed amounts — verify invoices, contracts, recurring payment history.
- Agency/escrow or payment-aggregation business (regulated PSP) performing pass-throughs — verify registration, licenses, and prior transaction patterns.
- Timing-based coincidence (multiple unrelated payors/receivers) — test counterparty linking, KYC identity matches, and decimal conservation.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

regulatory_citations.description: Retrieved passage IDs (e.g. PMLA-2002-*, PMLR-2005-*, RBI-KYC-2016-*, FIU-IND-RFI-*, FATF-*, SOP-*)

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.
